comment: Drum machine (kick, snare, closed hat, open hat, ride, crash, high tom, low tom). Song of two sections played in turn: BeatA for LenA bars with FillA on its last bar, then BeatB for LenB bars with FillB on its last bar (Skip or 1 to 64 bars); crash fills end on a crash. Kits on the Kit knob. Footswitch on = start from section A beat 1, off = stop. Guitar passes through at full level, mixed with the drums.
gid_comment: 0x07 = SFX (works on the G1Xon). The SONAME prefix and audio function name must match it (ZDL_SFX_, Fx_SFX_).
fxid_comment: 0x0208. Unused by Zoom's stock effects (neighbours 512 and 528 are stock) and, in SFX, by the repeat98, themanro and matujuice packs (themanro's NAM slots 500-699 are Delay). Under 1023, the most an original-MS patch can hold. Patches store it: never change it after release.

params.name: BeatA
params.comment: Section A (verse) beat, one per knob step (patterns.py BEATS; build.py sets max and default). Screen shows the beat name.

params.name: FillA
params.comment: Fill laid over section A's last bar (patterns.py FILLS, 0 = none; build.py sets max and default). Crash fills add a crash on section B's first downbeat.

params.name: LenA
params.comment: Section A length Skip / 1Bar .. 64BrM (patterns.py LENGTHS; build.py sets max and default).

params.name: FillB
params.comment: Fill laid over section B's last bar. Crash fills add a crash on section A's first downbeat (also when the footswitch starts the song).

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM = 40 + knob (1 BPM steps). Knob 80 = 120 BPM. Max 200: the linker gives this knob's handler stock APanDLY's 0..200 law (raw = knob / 100, up to 2.0). Screen shows the BPM.

params.name: Kit
params.comment: One knob step per kit in kits.py order; build.py overrides max with len(KITS) - 1. Screen shows the kit name.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for the first hardware smoke test: effect loads and shows 9 knobs over 3 pages, no DSP runs.
